source_snapshot.procedure: Run hbm_lvl1 then hbm_bw sequentially while separate amd-smi and AGT PM telemetry streams monitor mapped GPUs.
source_snapshot.criteria: AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], no new relevant dmesg error, no miscompare, zero RAS delta and bandwidth meeting approved criteria.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure two-command subset; omits amd-smi/AGT, RAS delta, miscompare and bandwidth/error policy.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores all four streams, sequential stress, timestamped log/RAS deltas and recovery.

old_problem: Tool versions, live AGT index map, bandwidth target/unit/window, miscompare semantics and RAS/new-dmesg policies are unspecified. Source asks to clear logs while requiring no new dmesg content. DeepSeek drops both monitoring streams and most acceptance dimensions.
disposition_reason: The two stress phases and five acceptance dimensions are explicit; missing tools/maps/thresholds are runtime Project Configuration. Logs are preserved and evaluated as baseline-to-window deltas. hbm_lvl1 and hbm_bw never overlap, while independently verified amd-smi and AGT streams must cover every mapped GPU throughout.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2059, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2060 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00014-V002 / a39d5df53d055f3b was directly read from XLSX.
Return code, HBM miscompare, RAS delta, new hardware-log delta and bandwidth are independent requirements; none substitutes for another.
An absolute zero RAS value is meaningless without counter-reset/history semantics, so signed baseline-to-post delta rules are used without clearing evidence.
Hard-coded AGT indices are accepted only after binding them to live GPU UUID/BDF/HBM identities; monitor failure invalidates observability.
Source order is preserved: hbm_lvl1 finishes before hbm_bw; full approved durations and bandwidth window remain.
No AGFHC/amd-smi/AGT run, HBM stress, login, monitoring, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Sequential HBM integrity/bandwidth with identity-bound four-stream monitoring
test_case.purpose: Qualify mapped GPU HBM integrity and bandwidth through sequential hbm_lvl1 and hbm_bw while complete amd-smi, AGT, RAS and kernel evidence proves no miscompare, error delta or health regression.
required_package: Exact row-2059 variant plus SUT/GPU/HBM/driver/firmware identities
Approved AGFHC hbm_lvl1/hbm_bw, amd-smi and AGT versions/checksums
Signed GPU UUID/BDF/HBM-to-AGT index map and monitor storage paths
Bandwidth target/unit/window, miscompare rules, RAS counter/event delta and relevant dmesg/journal policy
Dedicated no-load authorization, thermal/power/GPU aborts, evidence storage and recovery
test_case.test_command: STRESS-GATED; preserve timestamped kernel/journal/RAS baseline and verify all tool identities/maps. Start unique-output amd-smi and AGT monitors in separate sessions and prove every mapped GPU is observable. After authorization run hbm_lvl1 once to completion, then hbm_bw once; never overlap them. Retain full outputs/exits and continuously monitor GPU/HBM/RAS/thermal/power. Compare AGFHC_SUCCESS, miscompare, bandwidth, RAS and relevant log deltas independently. Stop on monitor loss or any fault; no clear or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: Both sequential phases complete with AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], no HBM miscompare, bandwidth meets the signed target/window, approved RAS counters/events have zero disallowed delta, no new policy-defined hardware error appears, and all mapped GPUs remain healthy within thermal/power limits with complete amd-smi/AGT evidence.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tools/maps/criteria, full four-stream observability, both sequential phases and all five acceptance dimensions. FAIL on nonzero exit/Status FAIL, miscompare, bandwidth miss, disallowed RAS/log delta, monitor gap, GPU loss or thermal/power abort. Missing package/map/threshold/approval is NOT READY; AGFHC success alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Heavy HBM stress requires dedicated authorized SUT and no competing GPU load.
Start and validate identity-bound monitors before stress; stop if either stream fails.
Run phases sequentially once with continuous thermal/power/GPU/RAS observation.
Preserve logs; no clearing, automatic rerun or retry after unexplained failure.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, tool identities and GPU/HBM/AGT map
Complete hbm_lvl1 and hbm_bw outputs/exits in order
Complete amd-smi and AGT files with hashes and no monitoring gap
Miscompare, bandwidth, RAS-delta, new-log and thermal/power/GPU analyses
No-clear/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On miscompare, RAS/log increase, monitor loss, GPU loss or thermal/power fault, stop the active phase and preserve all streams. Quiesce HBM work and use only approved GPU/service recovery under human control; do not run the next phase or rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Timestamped deltas, live monitor mapping and all five criteria replace log clearing, hard-coded indices and DeepSeek's two-command subset.

blocked.reason: The sequential method, evidence and recovery are complete; tools/maps/thresholds are supplyable runtime Project inputs.
